text: Safety Jogger is a brand of the Cortina Group: Cortina is a family-owned Belgian shoe company founded in 1950, and Safety Jogger (founded 2000) is one of its main brands.
short: Safety Jogger is a brand of the family-owned Cortina Group.

source.name: Safety Jogger: About Safety Jogger
source.quote: Our roots go back to 1950, when a small and family-owned shoe company Cortina was founded in Belgium.
source.note: Same page: 'Safety Jogger was founded in 2000 and quickly became one of the main brands' and 'Being part of Cortina allowed us to grow fast'; footer names FLA Europe NV, Oudenaarde. Page without a date; opened 2026-10-01.
